description: This source file defines the FileBasedWriteAheadLog class, which manages write-ahead log files for Spark Streaming. It handles writing, reading, recovering, and cleaning up log files, and includes internal classes and utility functions related to log file management.

classes.name: FileBasedWriteAheadLog
classes.description: Manages write-ahead log files for Spark Streaming, including writing, reading, recovery, and cleanup.

classes.name: FileBasedWriteAheadLog.LogInfo
classes.description: Data class representing log file information with start time, end time, and file path.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Synchronously writes a ByteBuffer to the log file, with retries on failure.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a ByteBuffer from a specified log segment.

methods.name: readAll
methods.description: Reads all existing log files and returns an iterator of ByteBuffers.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Deletes log files older than a specified threshold time, optionally waiting for completion.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Stops the log manager and closes open resources.

methods.name: getLogWriter
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the current log writer, handling rotation based on time.

methods.name: initializeOrRecover
methods.description: Initializes the log directory or recovers existing logs.
